capabilities: create tables with horizontally, vertically, and rectangularly merged cells
convert existing plain Markdown tables into the merged-table format
edit tables visually by dragging to select, merging, splitting, and adjusting rows, columns, and alignment
merge or split cells from a right-click context menu in reading view and live preview
preserve cell content and inline Markdown formatting when merging
extras: README is written in Chinese. Installation is manual (download from GitHub releases and place the folder in the vault); requires Obsidian 1.4.0 or higher. The README warns that converting a plain Markdown table to the merged format is one-way and recommends backing up notes first.
problem: Native Markdown tables in Obsidian cannot express colspan or rowspan, so cells cannot be merged horizontally or vertically.
summary: Table plugin that adds merged cells (colspan/rowspan) to Markdown tables via a merged-table code block format and a visual editor.
